mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the previous 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where CPIAUCSL annualized growth exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous 3 months signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the previous 3 months signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where HOUST increases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the previous 3 months signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to concerns about economic slowdown.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where INDPRO decreases by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is growing at an annualized rate of less than 2%, it indicates a tightening monetary policy without significant inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the previous 3 months signals a robust demand environment, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases and UNRATE decreases in 3 months
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over the previous month signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 0.5% over the previous quarter signals a contraction in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to concerns about a recession.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where GDPC1 decreases by more than 0.5%.
